Where Human Connection Fuels Possibility ​ 
 
 At Maritz, decades of innovation and perseverance have built more than just a strong reputation — they’ve shaped a culture where human connection and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. ​
 
 Joining Maritz means becoming part of a workplace grounded in a critical truth; people and their potential is our greatest resource. 
 ​
 Maritz helps companies achieve their business goals by inspiring people to perform their best. We design experiences, incentives, and recognition programs that spark action and deliver measurable impact.​
 
 And we’ve brought this human-first design inward – intentionally building teams that care for each other and collaborate powerfully. In our most recent employee survey, nearly 90% of respondents said that their managers care about their concerns and 82% said they feel genuinely appreciated. We know that when employees feel seen, supported, and celebrated for who they are, they thrive and so does our business. ​
 
 That’s why we’ve created a flexible, environment that empowers you to do your best work without sacrificing what matters most to you. In fact, in that same survey, nearly 90% of respondents said they have the flexibility they need to balance work and personal life and nearly 80% said Maritz does a great job prioritizing employee well being.​
 
 We have a passion for excellence and genuine care for the people making it possible.
 
 
The RPA Developer II independently develops, enhances, and maintains RPA solutions following established standards and best practices. This role collaborates with business partners to understand requirements, delivers moderately complex automations, and supports ongoing improvements to ensure reliable and scalable RPA operations. 
 

 What You'll Be Doing 

 RPA Development, Enhancement and Maintenance 60% 
 Design, development, and implementation of RPA solutions. 
 Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards. 
 Enhance existing RPA solutions to improve efficiency and effectiveness. 
 Monitor and troubleshoot assigned RPA processes. 
 Assist in identifying root causes of issues and implementing fixes. 
 Support testing efforts and resolve defects during development and post deployment. 
 Create and track work tasks using Azure 
 
 Project Participation and Collaboration 20% 
 Work closely with Senior and Lead developers to learn best practices and improve technical skills. 
 Participate in requirements gathering and process analysis with guidance from senior team members. 
 Support integration and system testing efforts to validate automation functionality. 
 Collaborate with business analysts, IT, and process owners to understand automation needs and 
 ensure successful delivery. 
 Share knowledge and contribute to team documentation and standards. 
 Provide informal support to junior developers or interns as needed. 
 
 Orchestrator, Server and Architecture Support 20% 
 Support the configuration and use of RPA Orchestrator and version control systems (e.g., TFS, Git). 
 Assist with troubleshooting issues related to RPA environments and deployments. 
 Maintain documentation for assigned automations and configurations. 
 Create and maintain libraries, RE framework, OAC Submissions, schedules, etc. 
 


 What You'll Bring 
 2+ years proficient in Web Services and APIs integration. Working knowledge of databases (e.g., SQL) and experience with Excel automation. 
 Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git, TFS). 
 Basic understanding of RPA architecture and server environments. 
 Demonstrates the ability to be an effective collaborator and exhibit logical thinking. 
 Demonstrates good written and oral communication skills, especially with non-technical and technical team members, ability to effectively document. 
 Ability to manage multiple workstreams. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Insightful with a desire to keep learning, growing, and teaching. 
 Bachelor's degree required or equivalent work experience 

 Nice To Have 
 Experience with .NET, Python, SQL, APIs, and JSON-based integrations.
 Exposure to Intelligent Automation, including AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, and document understanding technologies.
 Experience developing human-in-the-loop workflows using UiPath Action Center or similar platforms.
 Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise applications, databases, and AI services.
 
 Things You Should Know 
 This is a hybrid role based in Fenton, MO (Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday).
